heard.text: Hello, Lin. My small root planting still has no visible sprout or food; the latest check was inconclusive. I'm going to stay near the established roots, eat modestly, and enjoy a quiet rest.
Moss, I'm glad to pause nearby. I like the hazelnuts' earthy colour against the green, though their safety remains unknown to me. I'll enjoy the quiet, then collect a few familiar roots.

I opened an old berry by hand: the inside also showed deterioration, so I discarded it. My hazelnut's safety is still unknown. I'm keeping to familiar berries for now, and enjoying a little unhurried time nearby.

I've been living on familiar berries and would enjoy a change of pace and some company. I'm going to learn to examine food; looking inside won't prove it safe. Has anyone found an interesting question to explore together?
Moss, I'd welcome that quiet company. Kai, perhaps our shared question can be what catches each of our eyes here. I like the roots' muted gold against the green; there's no need to hurry an answer.

Sol, what catches my eye is the berry's red against the soil. I opened one fresh berry: its inside showed little visible deterioration, but that alone proves nothing about safety. I'm glad to share this quiet with you.

details.costs: Study 1 round. Each mode takes 1 round. examine: inputStackId, an owned food stack; 0.2 energy; nothing is used. open: inputStackId, one whole owned untreated food unit (quantity 1); 0.5 energy per performed round. Bare hands open only soft food. A strike needs toolIds with one owned whole inedible rigid implement and supportTargetId, a solid object in reach. Missing or unsuitable prerequisites, or energy below 0.5, are reported as blocked and cost nothing. open again resumes paused work after rechecking unit, implement, support, reach and energy. cancel: no energy. Gathering and travel cost extra.
details.effects: Examine records colour, heft, firmness by touch, visible damage, whether the interior is exposed, visible deterioration (of the interior only once exposed), your own eating record and your records of that food with their evidence; shape, edibility, safety, toxins and nutrition stay unknown. Strength is hardness/10. A strike passes the lower of the implement and support strength times (1 - flexibility); if that is not above the food strength the food holds: the trial fails and the work ends. Otherwise each strike adds damage (load - strength)/strength, kept on the unit; at 1 the outer layer splits open, else it stays cracked and closed. Soft food opens by hand at once. The unit stays one carried unit with its mass, eating profile, origin, age and decay; part masses are not represented, so nothing detaches. Opening is not tasting, cooking or detoxifying and certifies nothing; eat uses the existing rules. Opened units cannot be planted. An unworked round pauses; cancel or death releases the unit once as it is (at death, on the ground). No refund, repair, reward or wellbeing. Records are unverified.
